Our state of the art systems are distributed across fourdata centers and are operated for the Tübingen AI Center, the Cluster of Excellence ’MachineLearning: New Perspectives for Science’ and the Hertie Institute for AI in Brain Health. Everyday, researchers unleash thousands of compute jobs on our systems, training frontier-scaleneural networks and running experiments.The OpportunityOur clusters keep growing – more GPUs, more storage, and more services around them. Weare looking for an HPC Systems Eingineer who enjoys developing and running productioninfrastructure end to end: from bare-metal compute and the Slurm scheduler to the virtualizationlayer on which central service run, the storage backends and the automation that holds it alltogether. You will keep our systems fast and reliable, extend them as demand grows, and turnmanual work into reproducible, code-driven operations that the whole team can rely on. Youwill be joining a motivated team of HPC specialists who share responsibility for the wholestack, work closely, and have real room to shape how our infrastructure is built and run. Youwill also have the opportunity to shape two new directions: AI agents in our administrativeworkflows, and agent-native access to the clusters for our users.Your Tasks• Design and operate HPC clusters across four data centers – spanning inter-/intra-sitenetworks, SLURM scheduling, parallel filesystems (e.g., Lustre/Ceph), and GPUaccelerators – ensuring high availability and sustained throughput for researchworkloads.• Build and manage provisioning and configuration of heterogeneous compute, storageand network nodes (e.g. image-based provisioning, node lifecycle, Layer 2 and Layer 3networking)ML Cloud• Run and extend our Proxmox virtualization clusters hosting the management plane andinfrastructure services (HA, live migration, backup)• Operate and scale our storage platforms: provisioning,configuration, roll-outs and recurring maintenance• Build and operate monitoring, logging and alerting, and keep systems patched, hardenedand reliable through regular maintenance windows• Plan and carry out hardware roll-outs, capacity extensions and migrations together withvendors and data center staff• Bring AI agents into our admin workflows and build agent-native access to the clusterfor users.• Support and advise users on efficient cluster usage (job scheduling, data handling,storage layout, access workflows)Your Profile• Masters degree in Computer Science or a related field• Solid Linux administration experience in a production environment(RHEL/Rocky/Ubuntu)• Hands-on HPC experience: Slurm, parallel file systems (Weka, Lustre, Ceph), GPUworkloads (driver/CUDA, DCGM, Fabric Manager, NVLink/NVSwitch, MIG) andhigh-speed networks (InfiniBand, 400G Ethernet)• Solid data-center networking skills: Ethernet/IP (VLANs, routing, bonding/LACP),InfiniBand fabric management (subnet manager, fabric diagnostics), and firewall/VPNconfiguration• Experience operating Ceph and S3-compatible object storage (e.g. RADOS Gateway)at scale• Experience with virtualization for the management plane and infrastructure services(Proxmox, including clustering and backup)• Strong automation skills with Ansible (roles, inventories, CI-driven roll-outs) andscripting in Bash and Python• containers (Apptainer/Singularity/Docker), monitoring stacks (Prometheus/Grafana), ordatabase and service operations• A plus: Hands-on LLM tooling (tool calling and APIs, agent frameworks, retrieval andevaluation)• Independent, structured working style and good communication in English; German isa plus• A collaborative, user-facing mindset – comfortable supporting and advising researchersML CloudWhat We Offer• Technically deep, architecturally open work that directly enables cutting-edge machinelearningresearch• A small, senior team with flat hierarchy• Flexible working roadmapInterested? pipeline, opening doors, and closing business in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.What we offer you- Attractive remuneration package- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You'll make an impact by- Develop and execute the waste vertical go-to-market strategy, including portfolio positioning and the market introduction of Siemens' waste solutions- Drive pipeline creation and execution as the primary waste expert counterpart to regional sales teams, embedding directly in priority markets to accelerate opportunities from qualification to close- Lead and support customer engagements with major waste operators, municipalities, and OEMs, bringing the process knowledge, procurement understanding, and techno-commercial fluency to engage at every level- Coordinate cross-Business Unit activities to deliver a unified Siemens approach to the waste market and maximize share of wallet across the full waste value chain through verticalized offerings- Translate industry knowledge into sales enablement, equipping regional teams with the waste-specific tools, language, and insights needed to compete and win- Translate deep waste industry knowledge into portfolio requirements to shape Siemens' offering development and ensure solutions are positioned to win in the waste market- Monitor market trends and competitor positioning to keep Siemens' approach relevant, compelling, and differentiating- Feed customer and market insights into offering development, helping shape the next generation of Siemens solutions for the waste sectorThis is how you'll win us over- Education: Completed vocational training with further qualification as master/technician, extensive expertise and long-term, diverse professional experience; alternatively, completed bachelor's degree with long-term professional experience or completed master's degree with several years of professional experience- Experience and Skills:- Deep waste domain expertise – hands-on process knowledge combined with a strong understanding of industry procurement cycles, techno-commercial dynamics, and key stakeholder landscapes- A commercial mindset – proven track record of pipeline development, opportunity management, and closing business in complex, multi-stakeholder industrial environments- Customer credibility confident and compelling in senior and technical engagements with waste operators, municipalities, system integrators, and OEMs- Entrepreneurial drive — comfortable operating in a space that is being actively built, with the initiative to create structure and momentum where neither yet fully exists- Willingness to travel regularly across priority regions- Languages: English mandatory; German and other languages a strong advantageYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About UsThe world never stands still. jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer NeuroscienceFull- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieWe are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.Your responsibilities:The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.Depending on expertise, projects may include:- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly desirable is extensive experience with:- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. - Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram We look forward to meeting you!Contact: Sarah Mößmer | 089 / 4140 –2044 | Klinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieKlinik und Poliklinik für ChirurgieTUM KlinikumRechts der IsarIsmaninger Straße 2281675 MünchenIf the candidates’ suitability for the position in question is equal, severely disabled applicants shall be given preference. Interview-related costs can, unfortunately, not be reimbursed.
